riskTreatment.riskStatement: Runtime tenant isolation evidence is bounded to current local proof and does not close every service/capability row.
Authorization proof is bounded and requires source issue evidence before stronger claims.
Audit evidence is local and bounded until source acceptance proves required retention and operating depth.
Secret boundary proof is local and does not prove live-provider secret management.
Classification metadata is present but does not complete every downstream proof.
Retention, purge, and legal-hold behaviour remain source-depth work.

USF-211 proves bounded local cold backup/restore only; online backup, WAL archive, PITR, scheduled backup, DR rehearsal, RPO/RTO, provider-managed backup, and environment promotion remain unproven and non-claimed.
Incident workflow evidence is posture-only until alerting/dashboard/incident operating proof exists.
Local deterministic validation is not equivalent to SonarQube/static-analysis service operating evidence.
Telemetry evidence is bounded and no live alerting/dashboard readiness is claimed.
Operator/admin access posture is matrixed but runtime access review and clickthrough proof remain deferred.
Supplier/live-provider boundary evidence remains outside the current local foundation proof.
Proof data is synthetic and value-free, but retention/purge/legal-hold depth remains deferred.
